Captured live, never authored: two palette write logs of the packed protocols, each armed right
after `start` and read after `run_for(frames=600)`, and the palette device read by `palette` at
the same stop, the ground truth the decoding is judged by.
Program and board names were then replaced by neutral labels by a single mechanical substitution
that preserves every field width; nothing else was edited.

v30-alt-*   v30-alt (a MAME build carrying its driver, V30), the `latch` entry
           of v30-alt-palette.yaml, data port 0x8 and index port 0xa in the io space.
           v30-alt-dump-txt.gz   the dump the log's dumper wrote at that stop
           v30-alt-palette.json  `palette`'s `colors` for pens 0..1023, four pages joined
v30-*   v30 (a MAME build carrying its driver, V30), the `sequence` entry
           of v30-palette.yaml, data port 0x6 and reset port 0xe in the io space, armed
           where `start` parked, so the offset the driver zeroes as its video starts is known.
           v30-dump-txt.gz   the dump, as above
           v30-palette.json  `palette`'s `colors` for pens 0..255
*-palette.yaml   the entries the logs were armed from, read from each driver's source.

A change in what the dumper writes is RE-CAPTURED here, never patched in the fixture.
